about.text: Juju dhau, 'king of yoghurt' in Nepal Bhasa, is a thick, custard-like sweet curd from Bhaktapur, made by the Newar from boiled, sweetened buffalo milk and set in clay pots.

facts.v: Unglazed clay pot (kataro) with a clay lid, standing on rice husks and wrapped in warm cloth
Dense, custard-like: the clay absorbs water
